newsitem.title: USA: Sequent says sees Q2 EPS $0.20 to $0.23.
newsitem.headline: Sequent says sees Q2 EPS $0.20 to $0.23.

text.p: Sequent Computer Systems said Monday it expects to report earnings per share of $0.20 to $0.23 per share on revenue of $205 million to $210 million for the second quarter of fiscal 1997, ended June 28.
Sequent also said about $36 million from a 12-month contract with Boeing Co will be included in revenue in the second quarter.

The company said the potential value of the Boeing contract is $105 million, and includes intitial purchase orders for $59 million. Boeing plans to buy NUMA-Q 2000 systems and professional services from Sequent.
Sequent will release its actual earnings on July 17.
The company expects to report net income of $7.5 million to $8.5 million.
The Sequent systems, inluding disk storage subsystems manufactured by EMC Corp and tape libraries manufactured by Storage Technology Corp, will be used throughout Boeing.
The primary user of these systems is the DCAC/MRM (Define and Control Airplane Configuration/Manufacturing Resource Management) project of Boeing Commercial Airplane Group.
